contentEn:
Surrey is one of the fastest-growing cities in Metro Vancouver, and more homeowners here are tackling renovations than ever before. Whether you bought a townhouse in Fleetwood, a detached home in Cloverdale, or a basement suite in Newton, a well-planned renovation can dramatically increase your home's value and livability. This guide covers real costs, permit requirements, and timelines based on projects Reno Stars has completed across Surrey in 2025 and 2026.

Surrey Renovation Costs by Project Type (2026)

Surrey renovation costs are generally 5 to 12 percent lower than equivalent Vancouver projects, though prices vary by neighbourhood. Here is what most homeowners actually pay, based on completed Reno Stars contracts.

Project TypeTypical Range (CAD)Notes
Bathroom renovation$18,000 – $45,0003-piece to 5-piece; walk-in shower upgrades add cost
Kitchen renovation$35,000 – $75,000Cabinet replacement is the biggest line item
Full-house renovation$80,000 – $250,000+Scope-dependent; older homes may need structural work
Cabinet resurfacing$8,000 – $20,000Refinishing vs replacement; countertop extra
Basement renovation$30,000 – $80,000Suite-ready basements cost more (egress windows, plumbing)

These are contractor-supplied ranges including labour and materials. Always request a detailed line-item quote before signing a contract.

Permits and Regulations in Surrey

Surrey requires a building permit for most structural and functional changes. Key requirements:

  • Building permit: Required for work that changes structure, footprint, or major systems (electrical, plumbing, gas). Applications go through the City of Surrey Permit Centre.
  • CSBC certificate: Mandatory for contractors on projects over $5,000.
  • Structural engineer: Required before removing load-bearing walls or altering floor systems.
  • Strata properties: Townhouses and condos require strata council approval before work begins. Budget 2 to 4 weeks for strata approval in addition to permit timelines.

Surrey's planning department typically processes standard building permits in 2 to 4 weeks. Complex applications can take 6 to 8 weeks. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of its full-service offering.

Real Renovation Timelines

  • Bathroom renovation: 2 – 4 weeks
  • Kitchen renovation: 4 – 8 weeks
  • Basement renovation: 3 – 8 weeks
  • Full-house renovation: 3 – 6 months

Choosing a Surrey Renovation Contractor

Before signing, verify the contractor's BC residential builder licence through the BC Consumer Protection website. Insist on a fixed-price contract with a clear scope, payment schedule, and timeline. Ask for three recent Surrey-area references and call them.

Reno Stars has completed over a dozen projects in Surrey including a modern kitchen renovation in Guildford, a two-bathroom renovation in Fleetwood, and a full-home renovation in Newton. See real project examples: Modern kitchen renovation in Surrey and Two-bathroom renovation in Surrey.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home, or commercial renovation in Surrey? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. Every estimate includes an on-site walkthrough and a detailed line-item proposal.

Before You Start: Preparation Checklist

  • Define your scope in writing before getting quotes
  • Get at least three detailed quotes with line-item pricing
  • Verify contractor licence and insurance
  • Check your property title for covenants or easements
  • For strata properties: submit your renovation application to the council before signing any contract
  • Prepare a temporary bathroom or kitchen arrangement for the renovation period
  • Document existing conditions with photos

What does a bathroom renovation cost in Surrey?

A standard 3-piece bathroom renovation in Surrey typically starts around $18,000 and can reach $45,000 or more depending on fixture selections, plumbing reconfiguration, and whether walls or drains need to be moved. Walk-in showers, heated floors, and custom tiling add to the final cost.

How long does a Surrey renovation take?

Bathroom renovations take 2 to 4 weeks. Kitchen renovations take 4 to 8 weeks. Full-house renovations in Surrey commonly run 3 to 6 months. Strata properties add 2 to 4 weeks for council approval before permits can be filed.

Does Surrey require a permit for bathroom renovations?

Most bathroom renovations in Surrey require a building permit when they involve plumbing reconfiguration, structural changes, or electrical upgrades. Simple cosmetic work such as painting and flooring replacement may not require a permit. Confirm with the City of Surrey Permit Centre before starting.

Does Surrey strata allow renovations?

Surrey townhouses and condos governed by a strata corporation require council approval before work begins. Applications typically take 2 to 4 weeks. Any external changes or work affecting common property requires explicit council approval.

Surrey是Metro Vancouver增長最快的城市之一，越來越多屋主選擇進行裝修。本指南涵蓋實際費用、許可要求及工期，數據來自聚星裝修2025至2026年在Surrey完成的真實工程。

Surrey各類型裝修費用（2026年）

工程類型費用範圍（加幣）備註
浴室裝修$18,000 – $45,0003件式至5件式
廚房裝修$35,000 – $75,000櫃櫃更換為最大支出
全屋裝修$80,000 – $250,000+取決於工程範圍
地下室裝修$30,000 – $80,000Suite改造造價更高

許可證與法規

  • 建築許可：改變結構或主要系統（水電、排水、煤氣）的工程必須申請。
  • Strata住宅：城市屋及公寓在開工前需獲得Strata理事會批准，另需預留2至4週審批時間。

Surrey市標準建築許可通常在2至4週內處理。聚星裝修提供許可申請代辦服務。

工期參考

  • 浴室裝修：2至4週
  • 廚房裝修：4至8週
  • 全屋裝修：3至6個月

選擇承包商

簽約前請通過BC消費者保護網站確認承包商的BC省住宅建築商牌照。堅持採用固定價格合約，並索取至少三個Surrey地區的近期參考案例。

聚星裝修已在Surrey完成十多個項目，包括Guildford的廚房裝修、Fleetwood的兩浴室裝修及Newton的全屋裝修。查看真實案例：Surrey現代化廚房裝修。

想在Surrey規劃裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，免費上門估價。

Surrey浴室裝修需要多少錢？

標準3件式浴室裝修由約$18,000起，可達$45,000以上，視乎管線改動範圍及設備選型。

Surrey裝修一般需要多長時間？

浴室裝修2至4週，廚房裝修4至8週，全屋裝修3至6個月。分契住宅還需額外2至4週理事會審批。

Surrey裝修需要許可證嗎？

涉及管線改造、主體結構或電力升級的浴室工程通常需要建築許可。純裝飾性工程（如油漆和地板更換）可能不需要許可證。

Surrey分契住宅可以裝修嗎？

Surrey的分契式城市屋及公寓開工前需獲得Strata理事會批准，申請通常需2至4週。任何外牆改動或影響公共財產的工程均需理事會明確批准。
